column1: # Three fields a line, a TAB between them: section, key, value. Lines beginning with # are skipped.

#   free   little words that stand beside a name and are no part of it (articles, prepositions).

# Longer forms win over shorter ones, so "morgen früh" may stand beside "morgen".
